scope: The ten November candidates with no verified matches in the previous seven-outlet article research pass.
method: Searched exact candidate names and useful variants across established Georgia television, radio and newspaper outlets, followed primary publisher pages, and checked candidate identity, visible byline, publication date and publisher credentials. Article metadata and associations only; no copied article bodies.
notes: The Wiregrass Farmer guide supplies brief named mentions for nine target candidates; it is not an individual profile for each. WTOC separately reports on Christina Clement speaking to Savannah voters.
Justin Laster remains without verified coverage from a qualifying Georgia news outlet. This is a search result, not proof that no coverage exists.

Unsuffixed Leland Olinger reports and reports naming Olinger II were not attached to the existing Olinger III profile because that identity discrepancy remains unresolved. The Wiregrass Farmer uses the exact Olinger III name.

Excluded campaign websites, election aggregators, advocacy material, court records and unverified same-name arrest records. A campaign announcement in New York-based Black Star News was outside the requested Georgia-outlet scope.
Some search-tool access was blocked for Savannah Morning News, The Augusta Chronicle and WSAV. No absence-of-coverage conclusion is drawn from those access restrictions.
A generic Editor or collective Staff credit is not converted into a fictitious person or attributed to someone based only on their job title.

publisher_quality.evidence: Georgia Press Association public-notice directory lists the paper. University of Georgia archived masthead identifies its founding year and Turner County legal-organ role.
Original reporting published on the established Savannah television station’s own website with a named reporter and visible date.

articles.verification: The publicly visible publisher article lists the exact names of nine members of the target roster, plus Elbert Arthur Bartell. It does not name Justin Laster. Only visible metadata and named associations are imported; subscriber-only content was not accessed. The generic Editor byline is not attributed to a named person.

articles.title: Georgia’s Senate race heats up as four candidates pitch to Savannah voters
articles.verification: Publisher reports Clement speaking as a write-in U.S. Senate candidate at a Savannah candidate luncheon; has a separate section for Collins and names incumbent Ossoff. Visible byline and April 1 publication date verified. No fictitious person is created for WTOC Staff.
